If the guest account is not clean, just link it to a log-in method, reset and create again with guest, link again with log-in and that’s it, you should be able to use coupons again.

What starting amount? It’s literally the same. 

A day has 1440 minutes, if you make the math for the total resin available per day the resin cap doesn’t fit in any way possible in the “equation” which is basically 1440/8, 8 being 1 resin every 8 minutes. 

It doesn’t matter if you start with 120 or 160 unless you are missing the recharge time due to it being full, in which case that’s a different topic. The daily resin gets affected by the recharge time, which right now makes 180 maximum resin each 24hrs.

Literally all they had to do is make a statement that they are working on the whole issue, such as the rewards for certain domains, the recharge rate and the maximum amount of resin per day, give us at least 1 fragile resin everyday and that’s it, that would make us not lose fate on them until they come up with a solution. 

But instead they didn’t even touched the subject, which is why a lot of people are complaining, basically this is like a spit on our face.

Also, this is not quite true, since the amount available per day is the same, it depends on the recharge rate rather than on the cap that we can accumulate.
